_meta.description: Per-type_id config for Лагеря Беженцев (Refugee Camp) sheet. Universal — works for any save of any map. Each Refugee Camp row contains a monster (with count) that the player can recruit. Monster name and level are looked up from tbl_monsters_mapping.json (extracted from PRT TblMonsters).

78.notes: Refugee Camp (Лагерь беженцев). Reads monster_id at byte s+2 (u8), count at byte s+6 (u8, max 255). Looks up Monster name and Level from TblMonsters table. PRT MainForm.cs:10465 SaveCamp — r_CampRow.Monster = TblMonsters[monster_id][1], r_CampRow.Level = TblMonsters[monster_id][2], r_CampRow.Number = decmp[s+6].
